name: jinko
description: Search flights, hotels and car rentals, book trips, and manage bookings with the Jinko Travel API. Connects to the Jinko MCP server for live pricing, trip management, cancellation and payment.

interface.shortDescription: Flight, hotel and car-rental search, booking, and trip management
interface.longDescription: Search flights, hotels and car rentals, compare prices, book trips with ancillaries, and manage cancellations and refunds using the Jinko Travel API. Live flight pricing from multiple airlines.
defaultPrompt: Find the cheapest flights from Paris to New York next month
Book a round-trip flight from London to Tokyo
Find a hotel near the Colosseum in Rome for three nights in May
Rent a compact car at Lyon airport for the weekend, driver aged 35
Can I get a refund on booking JNK-A7B3X9?
